title: Technical Product Manager – Integrations & Connectors (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

Construction companies run their tenders across many tools. Your mission is to make Cosuno the place where it all comes together. Tenders should flow into Cosuno automatically from the systems our customers already use, and results should flow back out without anyone lifting a finger. The deeper Cosuno sits in our customers' processes, the more value we create for them.

At the same time, AI assistants like Claude and Gemini are becoming how people work. You'll launch our first MCP server so that our customers can analyze their data and operate Cosuno straight from their AI assistant.


How you'll get there:

  • Get to know our customers. Your first weeks are all about listening. You'll talk to customers and find out what it takes for our REST API and connectors to become part of their daily work. Together with Engineering, Customer Success and Sales, you'll turn those insights into a clear roadmap. You'll also set up the tracking that shows how much of our customers' work flows in through integrations.

  • Launch the first API improvements and our first MCP server. You'll shape both, write the engineering tickets and roll them out to our first pilot customers, all within your first few months.

  • Decide what comes next. Once real usage data and pilot feedback come in, you'll make clear recommendations on what to build and decide on the way forward together with our CTO and Head of Product.

  • Make integrations the norm. By the end of your first year, far more of our customers will run Cosuno connected to the tools they rely on, and you'll be the one who made it happen.

Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen.

Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde.
Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben.

About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

 

Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working?Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

 

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

 

Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match.

title: Senior Brand Marketing Manager (all genders)
description:
Über die Stelle

Pflege ist eines der größten gesellschaftlichen Probleme unserer Zeit. marta ist die führende Plattform, die den intransparenten Markt für 24-Stunden-Betreuung radikal verändert. Wir machen Pflege einfacher zugänglich, transparent und bezahlbar.

Wir haben viel ausprobiert und viel gelernt. Performance-Marketing läuft. TV haben wir zwei Jahre lang mit echtem Druck gefahren. Mailing, Print und Partnerschaften kennen wir aus eigener Erfahrung, nicht aus Fallstudien. Jetzt geht es um die zweite Stufe: aus einzelnen Kanälen ein System machen, das trägt, und aus marta eine Marke, die Familien kennen, bevor sie zum ersten Mal suchen.

Darauf arbeiten wir gemeinsam hin: die erste große Marke für Altenpflege in Europa. Die gibt es bisher nicht.

Wir suchen die Person, die das plant, koordiniert und schreibt. Du denkst dir Kampagnen aus und bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material. Du entscheidest mit, welchen Kanal wir als Nächstes aufmachen und in welcher Reihenfolge. Und du sprichst mit denen, die das möglich machen: Sendern, Veranstaltern, Partnern, Produktionen.

Wenn du es leid bist, deine beste Idee in einer Präsentation sterben zu sehen, ist das hier der Unterschied: keine Pitch-Runden, keine Freigabekette, keine dritte Feedbackschleife. Du stellst deine Idee dem Performance-Marketing und den Gründern vor, und ihr entscheidet im selben Gespräch. Was montags beschlossen wird, läuft spätestens in der Woche darauf.

Wir sind eine der größten Plattformen im deutschen 24-Stunden-Pflegemarkt, finanziert von führenden Investoren wie Capnamic, Almaz Capital, RTL Ventures und Swiss Health Ventures, mit einem bundesweiten Franchise-System und Teams in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig.

Level: Senior. Du planst und koordinierst: Kanäle, Budget, Timing, Briefings. Die Texte schreibst du selbst.

Almost every large company in the DACH region is facing the same task: the transformation to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI layer for S/4HANA transformation: we read code, processes and documentation, make the existing landscape transparent, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards — including in day-to-day operations, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.

The role

You'll be the person who decides what we build next, and why. You'll lead our two solution architects — the people who carry our SAP domain depth — and turn what they know about real transformation projects into a roadmap our engineers can ship. You'll work in close collaboration with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you'll spend real time with the people who use the product: consultants, IT leads, and transformation teams inside enterprise clients.

This is an early-stage PM role in the full sense: strategy and backlog, customer discovery and acceptance criteria, the big roadmap call and the unglamorous ticket. You'll do IC work alongside the thinking, and your decisions will show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.

Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 What you will do:

As a Customer Success Associate in EMEA, you will play a key role in scaling and strengthening our international post-sales experience as part of a growing global Customer Success organization. You will serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of mid-market customers, partnering directly with technical and business stakeholders to drive adoption, value realization, retention, and growth.

You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support while helping shape and evolve the Customer Success experience across the EMEA region.

We're currently looking for a Junior Influencer Marketing Manager (m/f/d) to join our team in Berlin. In this role, you'll own a portfolio of strategic creator partnerships for the German market and play a key part in driving revenue growth, brand awareness, and lasting business impact through high-performing influencer collaborations.

Your tasks

  • You own and develop a portfolio of strategic creator partnerships with clearly defined revenue, performance, and growth targets.

  • You identify, pitch, and secure creator collaborations with high potential and measurable business impact.

title: Junior Field Sales Executive (m/f/d) - Munich
description:
About us:

Saltz is an online food marketplace serving restaurants across multiple European markets. We help chefs and restaurants discover and source products from trusted local and international suppliers.


At Saltz, we believe the best ingredients should be accessible through one seamless marketplace experience. Restaurants purchase directly from Saltz and are fully supported across sales, logistics, customer support, account management, and claims handling. Through our catalogue and platform, we provide visibility into sourcing origins and product information, helping chefs make informed purchasing decisions and discover trusted suppliers worldwide.

We recently closed a €20M Series A backed by leading European venture funds. Our vision is to build the modern infrastructure layer for foodservice commerce - building the new standard for how the world sources food.
